# Eastlink Media

> Eastlink Media helps Chinese companies win overseas buyers and keep them, through the Eastlink Borderfree System: brand positioning, multilingual websites with SEO and GEO, LinkedIn and digital outreach, trade show strategy and follow-up, and cross-cultural sales training. Its founder's sister companies in Shenzhen also help brands abroad buy from China: sourcing, quality control, warehousing, fulfilment and shipping.

Key facts:

- Founder: Noel Murphy, who is Irish. He built his first websites in 2003 and co-founded ParcelFromChina in Shenzhen with Ouyang Ke in 2009. He has worked in China for 18 years, and the businesses he has built have sold more than $130 million.
- Who it's for: Chinese manufacturers, trading companies and brands that sell, or want to sell, to buyers in the US, the UK, Ireland and the rest of Europe.
- Languages: English and Chinese.
- Prices: websites have fixed prices from €1,195 / £1,195 / $1,595, with Care at €60 a month and the Grow SEO and GEO plan from €645 a month. Brand positioning, LinkedIn outreach, trade show work and training are quoted after a free growth review.
- Guarantee: on the Grow plan only, beat the agreed baseline by 25% within the agreed window or Eastlink keeps working for free. Eastlink does not guarantee orders.
- Contact: hello@eastlinkmedia.com

## The Eastlink Borderfree System

- [Eastlink Borderfree System](https://eastlinkmedia.com/borderfree-system): the five parts, what each includes, where to start, and FAQs
- [Websites, SEO and GEO](https://eastlinkmedia.com/seo-geo-authority): website packages and prices, SEO and GEO explained, results, latest launches and the Grow guarantee

## Results (all sites are live)

- China Fulfillment: 7,300 to 28,000+ visits a month, five months after Eastlink rebuilt the site (September 2026)
- Tech Aluminum: +$137,500 a month in new revenue after a multi-language rebuild
- Eriu Sourcing: 30+ keywords on page one of Google
- PFC Express: 4.8x the leads and 3.2x the search traffic after an English copy and SEO rebuild

## Buying from China

- [Buy from China](https://eastlinkmedia.com/buy-from-china): sister companies built by Eastlink's founder in Shenzhen
- [China Factory Sourcing](https://www.chinafactorysourcing.com/): supplier search, negotiation, contracts, buying, quality control and factory visits
- [China Fulfillment](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/): Shenzhen 3PL for ecommerce, crowdfunding and Amazon FBA, with DDP shipping; brands it has shipped for include Triangl, Spark Paws and Scrubba
- [Parcel From China / PFC Express](https://www.parcelfromchina.com/): express, postal, air and sea freight from China with more than 30 carriers
